SLF-family project flagged by the user, has its OWN findings.json site pin at 31.53N/-96.73W (Ben Hur Switching Station, ~20km west) -- confirmed geographically distinct, not a confusion risk. A separate, unrelated, geometrically-static tan borrow-pit/quarry ~1km NE of the anchor is visible unchanged across ALL 5 dates 2024-2026 -- confirmed pre-existing and NOT part of this project.

No claim of 'operational' is made from imagery alone.
